'''Lufta Shif''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the [[Education Advisor|Education Regent]] in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] under [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] rule.

==Biography==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] affiliated Lufta Shif<ref name="FF139" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|to]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FF139" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DB" /> She trained and worked as a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] and was soon elevated to a position at the capital [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] [[Theed University/Legends|eponymous university]]. She became an obvious candidate for the role of [[Education Regent]],<ref name="FF139" /> a role on the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] which spoke for all instructors,<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|NAB 9-14|Naboo – Theed Royal Palace}}</ref> after an illustrious career in Theed.<ref name="FF139" /> Shif was able to serve during [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] reign of Naboo.<ref name="DB" /> Knowing she was a teacher, Amidala listened to and respected Shif's opinions.<ref name="FF139" />

As Education Regent, Shif had the ultimate authority of educational concerns on Naboo, ranging from the smallest village nursery to the university she had once worked at. With the large amount of responsibility she had, Shif chose to concern herself with policy and large-scale reforms and not to work hands-on. She was also able to make sure enough of the [[Currency/Legends|Naboo royal budget]] was allocated to education.<ref name="FF139" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Shif was one of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Amidala's advisors gathered in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace's]] [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

During the invasion, Shif mingled with young people in prison camps in an attempt to keep their spirits up. and was able to get classes running. Shif using her inspirational skills was both a defiance of the Trade Federation, and an act of kindness to the children who needed a return to their normal lives and routines. Through her actions, she proved the importance and power of education<ref name="FF139" />

==Personality and traits==
The Education Regent was widely admired for her ability to inspire students. During the Invasion of Naboo, her work in prison camps were acts of kindness to the children there, and a defiance against the Trade Federation.<ref name="FF139" /> Shif had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]] worn up.<ref name="DB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Shif had inspirational skills she was admired for. She was able to prove these skills during the Invasion of Naboo.<ref name="FF139" />

==Equipment==
Shif garbed herself in the traditional teaching [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] of the Naboo. The gentle and flowing robes reflected the Naboo belief that learning is best encouraged by inspiration rather than threats of violence. She also wore a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] symbolic of her role as education regent.<ref name="FF139" /> Shif wore both clothing items during the Invasion of Naboo<ref name="TPM" /> in 32 BBY.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lufta Shif was portrayed by an uncredited extra in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
